texts.zh: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们要提醒你[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]正在做着危险的事情。[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经开始研究异端科技，不断地制造出更加复杂的人工智能以制造出真正拥有自我意识的机器。我们曾目睹过这种研究的下场，并觉得有义务警告你，这不仅威胁到他们自己，也威胁到其他种族。建议你们主动出击，阻止他们进一步的研究。
texts.en: [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! This is is a message to inform you of a dangerous development in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have begun to delve into heretical technologies, creating ever more complex artificial intelligences in pursuit of truly self-aware machines. We have seen where this path leads and feel it is our duty to warn you of the danger this poses not only to their own souls, but to those of all the younger races. We advise you to use your military might to attack them and force them to place a ban on any further such research.

label.en: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

title.zh: 任务：阻止人工智能研究

texts.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]要求我们制止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]开发智慧型人工智能的尝试。我们需要对他们开战，强迫他们禁止任何对人工智能的进一步开发。
texts.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to stop the attempts by [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] to develop sapient AI. We will need to make war on them and force them to ban all further AI research.
